name: Perth City Hotel — Games Rate
imgAlt: Modern hotel room with city view
desc: 4★ hotel in the CBD, walking distance to the Games Village and free Games-lane transport. Block rates held for registered participants.

name: Scarborough Beach Apartment
desc: Two-bedroom serviced apartments 200m from the sand — ideal for families and supporters. Sleeps 4.

name: Athlete Budget Stay — Northbridge
desc: Clean, social, central. Twin-share rooms in Perth's entertainment quarter, 10 minutes from the Village.

name: Airport Meet & Transfer
imgAlt: Traveller with luggage at an airport
desc: Door-to-door transfer with a Games volunteer welcome at Perth Airport. Bikes and oversized sports gear included.

name: Games Venue Shuttle Pass
desc: Unlimited shuttle travel across all nine venue clusters for the full 12 days. Accredited participants also travel free on public transport.

name: Rottnest Island Day Trip
desc: Ferry, bike hire and a day on car-free Rottnest. Meet a quokka, swim The Basin, ride the coast road.

name: Swan Valley Food & Wine Trail
desc: A guided half-day through WA's oldest wine region — wineries, breweries, chocolate and honey, 25 minutes from the city.

name: Noongar Cultural Walk — Kings Park
imgAlt: Walking trail through native bushland above a city
desc: Walk Whadjuk Noongar country with a local guide — six seasons, bush foods and stories above the city skyline.

name: Opening Ceremony Priority Seating
desc: Reserved lower-bowl seating at Optus Stadium for the Opening Ceremony, 12 October 2029.

name: Games Village Long-Table Feast
imgAlt: Long dinner table with candles and food
desc: A WA produce long-table dinner in the Games Village — seafood, Margaret River wines, and 500 new friends.

name: Margaret River Escape — 3 Days
imgAlt: Surf beach and headland at sunset
desc: Three days south: tall-timber forests, world-class surf breaks, caves and 90+ cellar doors. Coach + boutique stay included.

name: Ningaloo Reef & Coral Coast — 5 Days
imgAlt: Turquoise reef water meeting white beach
desc: Fly north to swim a World Heritage reef straight off the beach. October is humpback season.

name: Kimberley Explorer — 6 Days
desc: Gorges, waterfalls and 40,000 years of culture in Australia's wild north-west. Small-group, guide-led.

name: Games Concierge Service
imgAlt: Concierge shaking hands with a guest
desc: A real human plans your whole trip — restaurant bookings, schedule changes, family logistics, in-Games support.
